description:
Turn your images and videos into a personal knowledge base. Turn your images and videos into a personal knowledge base. Search, organise, and rediscover the media you've saved, with automatic collections and concepts that help you find information you might otherwise forget. Search
  • Find images and videos using text or image search
  • Search by tags or tag + text queries
  • Search from other apps using share or intent
  • Paste images directly into the search bar
Automatic Collections
  • Automatically group visually similar media into collections
  • Browse related photos and videos without manually organising them
Concepts
  • Organise media by meaning, not just appearance
  • Create concepts around topics or ideas and automatically find matching media using descriptions
  • Generate image descriptions automatically or add and edit descriptions yourself
Tagging
  • Add tags to your media
  • Use tag autocomplete when searching or tagging
Duplicate Management
  • Detect duplicate media
  • Filter your library to include, exclude, or show only duplicates
Privacy
  • SmartScan is offline-first
  • Your media, tags, collections, concepts, and generated descriptions are stored and processed on your device
  • Generating image descriptions optionally uses cloud processing and requires an internet connection
